## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`PackagedAutomationPage.test.tsx` 里的 `CLONE_NOTICE` 夹具换成服务端 `FLOW_CLONE_NOTICE` 的当前单行文案。
- 为什么改:#28072 已把服务端提示改成一句话,夹具仍是旧的七句话,测试读到的不是服务端实际发送的内容。
- 风险与回滚:仅测试夹具,不发布、不影响运行时;回滚即还原这一个字符串。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.test.tsx` 约 L100-103,唯一的 hunk。
- 两分钟验证:在 `ui/` 目录执行 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.test.tsx`,预期 31 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The `CLONE_NOTICE` fixture now carries exactly the text of `FLOW_CLONE_NOTICE` in `packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts` (one line). It stays a literal copy: `@object-ui/app-shell` does not depend on `@objectstack/runtime`, and a test-only import would add a new dependency edge.

## Tests

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.test.tsx` from `ui/`: 1 file, 31 tests passed.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

Test-only change in a private package; no changeset (skip-changeset declared at pr_create).
